about: Ben Denckla's readings of the Koren edition at the candidates listed in doc/meteg-after-silluq-koren-lookup-candidates.md, one per reference, in the order he reported them. 'koren' classifies Koren's metsil or metsils only relative to the two U+05BD positions on MAM's final atom: 'first' means a metsil at MAM's first position but not its last, 'last' means a metsil at MAM's last position but not its first, and 'both' means metsils at both positions. A metsil at another position is recorded in 'note' and does not affect this classification. 'sheva', present only where Ben gave a vocal-or-silent judgment and Koren has a simple sheva in the relevant position, is Koren's treatment of the simple sheva after MAM's first U+05BD position. 'note', present only where needed, records additional Koren pointing not represented by 'koren' or 'sheva', including an additional metsil, Koren's treatment of another sheva, or a different vowel or sheva at the relevant position. 'date' is the day Ben reported the reading. A throwaway writer, which is not tracked, fills the generated comparison from this list.
